annotations.title: Check a proof as IRIS does

description: Applies the rules referee IRIS runs to one proof (a CI check run, a FHIR Observation or an HL7 ORU message) against a brief's milestones, and returns met or not met per milestone with the reason. Nothing is signed and no money moves.
name: knos_iris_check_proof
